scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @arcane-commons/api lint && pnpm --filter @arcane-commons/desktop lint && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @arcane-commons/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @arcane-commons/desktop typecheck && cargo check --workspace --all-features
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @arcane-commons/api test && pnpm --filter @arcane-commons/desktop test && cargo test --workspace --all-features
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @arcane-commons/api build && pnpm --filter @arcane-commons/desktop build && cargo build --workspace --all-features
